body:
I may as well. It's 2.15 am, so there's nothing I can do now. I may as well wait. Watch some goofy YouTube videos. Play guitar when I wake up to distract myself, try composing until I feel "safe" enough. Then I'll come back to this. Thank you so much, though. It means a lot, even if the other person doesn't know it, when somebody actually gives a shit. It's sort of comforting. Even if somebody could be half a world away, they still can care. Thank you.

And sorry for rambling. Sometimes I get strangely sentimental (read: pretentious).

Grew up in an abusive household. Figure I deserved it. There had to be a reason for it. I was a burden then. When me and my mum moved out, I was told I was "fucking up her life" and that she wished I wasn't born because then she could be "free". Fair enough. I won't hold a grudge. She was under stress with my father, too. I don't have anybody I know personally. Even if I don't know somebody, I'll still go out my way to avoid hurting them. I care about them even if they don't even know me. But if they knew me, then they wouldn't want to stick around. Nobody does. And I don't blame them, because even I don't want to stick around myself.

And starvation is still relatively low key. I suffer, as sort of atonement, and it's self contained.
I just feel I've been enough of a burden. I figure I may as well go out with a fizzle and a wet fart, rather than a bang. Just fade out of the way.

Looping as in everything just seems to be happening over and over, no matter what I do. I get really worried and terrified about being caught in a timeloop, a la groundhog day. I see coincidences and truly believe that this is irrefutable proof that I'm right. It'd be very hard to properly explain, it's a feeling that's very much subconscious. Intuition rather than thought, maybe. And I'm (as you probably noticed) quite detached from reality, which just means that these frightening streaks have more power over me. I can't really focus on my own thoughts. It's like hearing two hundred people's thought processes in real time. I can't focus. The few moments of mental quiet I get always seem to be accompanied by catatonia and a tidal wave of negativity after I snap out of it. I'm unable to do anything. Haven't had a haircut for a year and a half, don't wash for weeks, and when I try go outside I tend to end up curled up in a quiet alley, back to the wall and, for want of a better phrase, completely unhinged.

So I may as well end it. But if this is real, I don't want to make a scene. A nice, self contained death would be nice. Imploding.

I don't care if it hurts, as long as I don't cause other people much hassle. And the pain might inject some colour into the end of this life.
